info.title: API.SH: The Knot
info.description: The The Knot API from API.SH: public The Knot data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: The Knot vendor categories and filters
get.description:
Without `category`: the 25 vendor categories (code, slug, name, link). With `category`: the category's details (description, singular and plural names), every filter it offers with each option value (use them as `param:value` in /theknot/v1/search `filters`), the sort options and the full category list.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 2 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/theknot-categories

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Optional category slug, code or name to get its filters.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

category.name: Reception Venues
category.description: Venues suitable for hosting wedding receptions.

get.description:
Without `state`: the 50 states with their slugs. With `state`: that state's cities with the `location` value for /theknot/v1/search (e.g. `albany-ny`), its top cities, and the recommended vendors the state page shows for each city (same fields as search results).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 2 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/theknot-locations

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Optional state name or slug (`new-york`, `texas`, `california`).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Optional category (default `wedding-reception-venues`); sets the category of the city links and recommended vendors.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Wedding vendors and venues in one city and category as The Knot lists them, 30 per page: name, storefront link, category, short description, rating and review count, AI review summary, street address with coordinates, service area, estimated costs (budget range, ceremony, catering per guest, bar per guest, reception), facets (ceremony types, styles, services), photo and logo, vendor tier, deals, plus the category's filters with every option value, the price histogram and the total. Filters are passed as `param:value` pairs taken from the `filters` list (e.g. `guest_capacity:101-150,settings:rooftop`); several values of one filter match any of them. Page with `page`; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 3 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/theknot-search

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Vendor category: slug (`wedding-reception-venues`, `wedding-photographers`, `florists`, `wedding-djs`...), code (`REC`, `WPH`...) or name. See /theknot/v1/categories.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City and state code as The Knot writes it: `chicago-il`, `new-york-ny`, or `Austin, TX`. /theknot/v1/locations lists each state's cities.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Comma-separated `param:value` pairs from the `filters` list of this category (e.g. `guest_capacity:101-150,settings:rooftop,settings:barn`, `distance:within-25-miles`, `business-attributes:woman-owned-business`, `deals:all-deals`). An unknown value answers 404. `starting_price_range` takes only `affordable` (the numeric price bands are not available).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `recommended` (default, the site's banded-distance ranking) or `featured`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Results page, 1-based (30 vendors per page).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One wedding vendor's storefront: name, category, headline, full description, AI review summary, rating and review count, price range, starting price range, estimated costs and seasonal pricing (peak and off-peak averages and minimums), guest capacity, weddings hosted, service area, address with coordinates, business phone, email and website, social profiles, amenities, awards (Best of Weddings years), facets (ceremony types, styles, services offered), the vendor's pricing FAQ, review topics, the team bio, logo and every photo, tier and claim status, plus `raw` with the site's full record.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 2 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/theknot-vendor

parameters.name: vendor
parameters.description: The vendor: its numeric id (the number at the end of its link, e.g. `592451`) or its theknot.com/marketplace/... link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every review of a vendor, as its storefront's review list shows them, oldest included: reviewer display name (first name and initial), star rating, date, title, full text, verified flag, highlighted flag, wedding date when given, the vendor's reply and review photos, plus the overall rating, total review count and AI review summary. Sort by newest, oldest, highest or lowest rating; filter by stars, to reviews with photos, or by words in the text. Phone numbers inside review text are hidden. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 2 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/theknot-vendor-reviews

parameters.name: vendor
parameters.description: The vendor: its numeric id (e.g. `592451`) or its theknot.com/marketplace/... link.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Reviews per page, 1-50 (default 25).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order (default newest).

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with these stars, e.g. `5` or `1,2`.

parameters.name: with_photos
parameters.description: Only reviews with photos.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only reviews whose text contains these words.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
